name: Yagami Yukihiro
source:
Touko's son. He is always going off to baseball practice, a sport that he loves.

He is wary of men trying to get close to Touko, lashing out that he is the one to protect his mother.

Whenever Tsubasa is mentioned, he runs away immediately with a blush on his face.

[Translated from [url=http://venus66.sakura.ne.jp/yukihiro.html]the official site[/url]]
